**brief:** a prompt that is only a `<pasted_content>` block is no longer declined as not about code. With nothing typed, the brief reads the head of the paste's first paragraph and the tail of its last (600 characters at most, links dropped) as plain language, so the relevance gate decides it whatever identifiers the paste holds. Ops-only, one-word and link-only pastes stay declined. The decision log's `typed` holds that excerpt for such a prompt, credential shapes masked.
